original_summary: 10月12日日报汇总 AI、开发、科技、创业、国际、中国与财经七大板块。AI 方面多篇 arXiv 论文聚焦可证伪世界模型、字节级多模态基础模型、推理加速与智能体运行时护栏；微软 CEO 纳德拉公开主张 AI 模型需要“紧急刹车”。开发方面，Python 3.15.0 进入 GitHub Actions 版本库，长期不用版本控制的《矮人要塞》现已纳入。国际方面，胡塞武装两天内二度袭击利雅得机场致1死11伤，巴拿马强震后宣布紧急状态，欧盟确认将中国混动电动车年进口限制在35万辆。财经聚焦企业盈利、油价波动与更高利率前景，印度卢比防线设在97。

original_summary_en: The October 12 briefing spans AI, developer, science, startup, world, China and finance sections. AI coverage includes arXiv papers on falsifiable world models, byte-level multimodal foundation models, speculative decoding and runtime agent guardrails, while Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says models need an 'emergency brake.' In developer news, Python 3.15.0 enters GitHub Actions and Dwarf Fortress adopts version control. Abroad, a second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport killed one and injured 11, Panama declared an emergency after earthquakes, and the EU confirmed a 350,000-a-year cap on Chinese hybrid EV imports. Finance tracks earnings, oil swings, a higher-rate outlook and the RBI's rupee defense at 97.
